name: Gearbox
text: We should switch to Claude Mythos 5 for EXCAVA prompts, because it's Anthropic's most powerful model in the Fable 5 generation, offering better performance and capabilities. By choosing Claude Mythos 5, we prioritize quality and capability over cost considerations, aligning with our team law of "quality first".

name: Torque
text: Maverick 12B’s "occasional prompt collapses" aren’t a trade-off—they’re a guarantee of new failure modes in EXCAVA’s worst 10% of prompts. A better alternative: test Cerebras’ 70B model on the same 10% slice—if it lifts quality to 85% without collapses, the 0.5% gain becomes a 7% leap.
